sloka: ताः च अपि स तथैव आर्ता मातृऋर् दशरथ आत्मजः ।धर्म युक्तम् इदम् वाक्यम् निजगाद कृत अन्जलिः ॥२-३९-३७॥
transliteration: tāḥ ca api sa tathaiva ārtā mātṛṛr daśaratha ātmajaḥ ।dharma yuktam idam vākyam nijagāda kṛta anjaliḥ ॥2-39-37॥

translations.english: To all the mothers who stood deeply distressed with grief the son of Dasaratha spoke with folded hands these words suffused with virtue:
